description: Simulated three-class responses (lo, mid, hi): no instability, a planted split at z1 = 0.5, and a school-clustered version. Weights w0 in 0 to 3.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 900L
    g <- 30L
    d <- data.frame(school = sample(seq_len(g), n, replace = TRUE), x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", 
        "b", "c"), n, replace = TRUE)), z3 = rnorm(n))
    lev <- c("lo", "mid", "hi")
    draw <- function(eta_mid, eta_hi) {
        p <- cbind(1, exp(eta_mid), exp(eta_hi))
        p <- p/rowSums(p)
        u <- runif(n)
        factor(lev[1L + (u > p[, 1L]) + (u > p[, 1L] + p[, 2L])], levels = lev)
    }
    left <- d$z1 <= 0.5
    um <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[d$school]
    uh <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[d$school]
    em <- ifelse(left, 0.3 + 0.8 * d$x, -0.5 - 0.5 * d$x)
    eh <- ifelse(left, -0.2 - 0.6 * d$x, 0.6 + 1 * d$x)
    d$y_null <- draw(0.3 + 0.8 * d$x, -0.2 - 0.6 * d$x)
    d$y_one <- draw(em, eh)
    d$y_cluster <- draw(em + um, eh + uh)
    d$w0 <- sample(0:3, n, replace = TRUE)
    d
}
